## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List relevant checks and any remaining limitations. Confirm examples use isolated data and contain no credentials or applicant information.

## Directory data, if changed

Name the country/pack and affected record IDs. Include public evidence URLs, the date checked and any unresolved details. For a new pack, describe its coverage and source/reuse notes; see `docs/DIRECTORY-CONTRIBUTING.md`. Report the result of `node scripts/marketing/build-directory-pack.mjs --check` when submitting a pack definition or source change.

- [ ] Existing source IDs and original evidence are preserved; unknown contacts, ownership and eligibility are not invented.
- [ ] The original UAE research snapshot is unchanged; no private tracking, generated ZIPs or build output is included.

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material and have retained source-specific reuse terms and attribution.
